mapper.select: SELECT g.id, g.name, g.strategy, g.max_fails AS maxFails, g.fail_timeout AS failTimeout, g.status, g.created_time AS createdTime, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM group_link gl WHERE gl.group_id = g.id AND gl.status = 1) AS linkCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM forward f WHERE f.group_id = g.id) AS forwardCount FROM lb_group g ORDER BY g.created_time DESC
